, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly broadened instructions to consult alternative reputable sources (e.g., Deutsche Biographie/NDB) to corroborate the death date, WebSurfer repeated the same Britannica-focused query instead of following those directions, causing an unproductive loop and failing to provide the requested independent confirmation.
